id, tenant_id, shop_id, tid, yz_open_id, order_status, is_paid, ordered_at, paid_at, payment_fen, refunded_fen, title_summary, items_json, synced_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_youzan_annual_profile ( tenant_id, shop_id, yz_open_id, customer_id, display_name, gender_hint, weixin_open_id_hash, weixin_union_id_hash, mobile_hash, mobile_masked, order_count, total_payment_fen, first_order_at, last_order_at, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{profile.tenantId}, #{profile.shopId}, #{profile.yzOpenId}, #{profile.customerId}, #{profile.displayName}, #{profile.genderHint}, #{profile.weixinOpenIdHash}, #{profile.weixinUnionIdHash}, #{profile.mobileHash}, #{profile.mobileMasked}, #{profile.orderCount}, #{profile.totalPaymentFen}, #{profile.firstOrderAt}, #{profile.lastOrderAt}, #{profile.syncedAt} ) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE customer_id = COALESCE(new_row.customer_id, crm_youzan_annual_profile.customer_id), display_name = CASE WHEN new_row.display_name IS NOT NULL AND new_row.display_name != '' AND new_row.display_name != '鲸选贵宾' THEN new_row.display_name ELSE crm_youzan_annual_profile.display_name END, gender_hint = CASE WHEN new_row.gender_hint != 'UNKNOWN' THEN new_row.gender_hint ELSE crm_youzan_annual_profile.gender_hint END, weixin_open_id_hash = COALESCE(new_row.weixin_open_id_hash, crm_youzan_annual_profile.weixin_open_id_hash), weixin_union_id_hash = COALESCE(new_row.weixin_union_id_hash, crm_youzan_annual_profile.weixin_union_id_hash), mobile_hash = COALESCE(new_row.mobile_hash, crm_youzan_annual_profile.mobile_hash), mobile_masked = COALESCE(new_row.mobile_masked, crm_youzan_annual_profile.mobile_masked), synced_at = new_row.synced_at

INSERT INTO crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot ( tenant_id, shop_id, tid, yz_open_id, order_status, is_paid, ordered_at, paid_at, payment_fen, refunded_fen, title_summary, items_json, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{order.tenantId}, #{order.shopId}, #{order.tid}, #{order.yzOpenId}, #{order.orderStatus}, #{order.paid}, #{order.orderedAt}, #{order.paidAt}, #{order.paymentFen}, #{order.refundedFen}, #{order.titleSummary}, #{order.itemsJson}, #{order.syncedAt} ) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_status = new_row.order_status, is_paid = new_row.is_paid, ordered_at = COALESCE(new_row.ordered_at, crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot.ordered_at), paid_at = COALESCE(new_row.paid_at, crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot.paid_at), payment_fen = new_row.payment_fen, refunded_fen = new_row.refunded_fen, title_summary = new_row.title_summary, items_json = new_row.items_json, synced_at = new_row.synced_at
mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p0.shop_id) FROM crm_youzan_annual_profile p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p0.shop_id = #{shopId}) AS shop_count, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS profile_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS linked_customer_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN weixin_open_id_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open_id_bound_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN weixin_union_id_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS union_id_bound_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mobile_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mobile_bound_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.is_paid = 1 AND o.shop_id = #{shopId}) AS paid_order_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, o.payment_fen - o.refunded_fen)), 0) FROM crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.is_paid = 1 AND o.shop_id = #{shopId}) AS total_payment_fen, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_h5_c_visit_session v WHERE v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.shop_id = #{shopId}) AS unified_visit_sessions, MAX(synced_at) AS last_synced_at FROM crm_youzan_annual_profile WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT o.id, o.tenant_id, o.shop_id, o.tid, o.yz_open_id, o.order_status, o.is_paid, o.ordered_at, o.paid_at, o.payment_fen, o.refunded_fen, o.title_summary, o.items_json, o.synced_at, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot o INNER JOIN crm_youzan_annual_profile p ON p.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND p.shop_id = o.shop_id AND p.yz_open_id = o.yz_open_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.is_paid = 1 AND COALESCE(o.paid_at, o.ordered_at) >= #{yearStart} AND COALESCE(o.paid_at, o.ordered_at) < #{yearEnd} ORDER BY COALESCE(o.paid_at, o.ordered_at) ASC, o.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_youzan_annual_order_snapshot WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (
(shop_id = #{ident.shopId} AND yz_open_id = #{ident.yzOpenId})
)
AND is_paid = 1
SELECT id FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_h5_c_identity_binding ( tenant_id, channel_type, openid_hash, unionid_hash, shop_id, yz_open_id, customer_id, mobile_hash, bound_via ) VALUES ( #{binding.tenantId}, #{binding.channelType}, #{binding.openidHash}, #{binding.unionidHash}, #{binding.shopId}, #{binding.yzOpenId}, #{binding.customerId}, #{binding.mobileHash}, #{binding.boundVia} ) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE unionid_hash = COALESCE(new_row.unionid_hash, crm_h5_c_identity_binding.unionid_hash), shop_id = COALESCE(new_row.shop_id, crm_h5_c_identity_binding.shop_id), yz_open_id = COALESCE(new_row.yz_open_id, crm_h5_c_identity_binding.yz_open_id), customer_id = COALESCE(new_row.customer_id, crm_h5_c_identity_binding.customer_id), mobile_hash = COALESCE(new_row.mobile_hash, crm_h5_c_identity_binding.mobile_hash), bound_via = new_row.bound_via
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, channel_type, openid_hash, unionid_hash, shop_id, yz_open_id, customer_id, mobile_hash, bound_via, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_h5_c_identity_binding WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND unionid_hash = #{unionidHash} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, mobile_hash, code_hash, attempt_count, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM crm_h5_sms_verification WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_h5_c_visit_session ( tenant_id, shop_id, yz_open_id, customer_id, display_name_snapshot, report_year, session_key, entry_channel, first_open_at, last_active_at, visible_duration_ms, max_scene_reached, viewed_scene_count, viewed_scenes_json, scene_durations_json, ignited_lamp, opened_order_count, toggled_privacy, generated_poster, clicked_book_butler, client_device ) VALUES ( #{session.tenantId}, #{session.shopId}, #{session.yzOpenId}, #{session.customerId}, #{session.displayNameSnapshot}, #{session.reportYear}, #{session.sessionKey}, #{session.entryChannel}, #{session.firstOpenAt}, #{session.lastActiveAt}, #{session.visibleDurationMs}, #{session.maxSceneReached}, #{session.viewedSceneCount}, #{session.viewedScenesJson}, #{session.sceneDurationsJson}, #{session.ignitedLamp}, #{session.openedOrderCount}, #{session.toggledPrivacy}, #{session.generatedPoster}, #{session.clickedBookButler}, #{session.clientDevice} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_h5_c_visit_session SET last_active_at = #{session.lastActiveAt}, visible_duration_ms = #{session.visibleDurationMs}, max_scene_reached = #{session.maxSceneReached}, viewed_scene_count = #{session.viewedSceneCount}, viewed_scenes_json = #{session.viewedScenesJson}, scene_durations_json = #{session.sceneDurationsJson}, ignited_lamp = #{session.ignitedLamp}, opened_order_count = #{session.openedOrderCount}, toggled_privacy = #{session.toggledPrivacy}, generated_poster = #{session.generatedPoster}, clicked_book_butler = #{session.clickedBookButler}, client_device = #{session.clientDevice} WHERE tenant_id = #{session.tenantId} AND id = #{session.id}
